title: cart_pricing row
description: One row of cart_pricing.csv: a cart line and the totals the pricing rule must reproduce.

quantity.description: Units ordered. Integer >= 1; a CSV cell is text, so the decimal-string form is accepted too.

unit_price_cents.description: Unit price in cents. Integer >= 1; a CSV cell is text, so the decimal-string form is accepted too.

discount_percent.description: Whole-percent discount in 0..100; a CSV cell is text, so the decimal-string form is accepted too.

expected_tier.description: Pricing tier: bulk when quantity >= 4, standard otherwise.
